title: Fix CreateStreamDialog accessibility: missing focus trap and role
description: The CreateStreamDialog in landing-page.tsx has accessibility issues: (1) No role='dialog' or aria-modal='true' on the modal content div — screen readers won't announce it as a dialog. (2) No focus trap — users can Tab out of the modal into the background content. (3) No Escape key handler to close the dialog (onKeyDown with Escape only handles Enter for submission). (4) The overlay div uses aria-label='Create value stream dialog' but aria-label on a non-landmark div isn't announced — it should be on the dialog content div instead. Fix: Add role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' to the inner content div, add onKeyDown handler for Escape to close, and implement a focus trap (or use a lightweight focus-trap library). The autoFocus on the input is good but insufficient without the trap. The StreamMetadataForm has the same issues. Both should follow the WAI-ARIA dialog pattern.
